_why: Documented deviations from invariant I2 (transport state separate from business state), enumerated 2026-08-25 by the AI-harness audit, chantier CH-06. These crossings exist because the transport layer physically lives INSIDE the kernel tree, at src/core/transport/ (ARCH-14): the daemon and its boot wiring are transport concerns sitting in src/core/, and they reach into src/mcp/ to build the tool registry. The deviation is assumed, not accidental — the guard's job for now is to stop it GROWING.
_liftedBy: CH-23 — the labre-mcp façade refactor. It moves transport out of src/core/ and inverts the boot dependency, at which point rule TRANSPORT_TO_MCP no longer applies and every entry below is deleted along with it. Nothing here is a to-do list for a passer-by: shrinking this file is CH-23's work, not a drive-by fix.
_format: One object per tolerated finding: {file, rule, specifier, why}. Literal triples only — no wildcard, no 'at most N' threshold, either of which would let a brand-new violation hide behind an old one. An entry matching no finding fails the guard (rule STALE), so this file can never drift away from the tree it describes.
